original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.

actual_scope: Independent arithmetic-layer audit of PR #3653's conditional composition claim (retimed T530 suppliers x literal T488 allocation, publication head 607a09ff441c79b215a8127a81f4cc70021d0d9b, bytes bound by SHA-256): recompute the published aggregate identities (rank mass 65088*488, 4392 = 488*9 calls, 437248 = 896*488 live, 437757 physical families, 1791936 roles), re-derive the moment root bracket M(a) = sum_r profile[r]*r^(1-a) - 437248*73^(1-a) with two engines, confirm the strict sign straddle at the two published adjacent decimal endpoints, local uniqueness at the bracket, the released-string construction with the two inherited margins, and the exact endpoint delta against pinned PR #3642 (0.001730394391813963415120). Four rejection controls. No word, owner journal, native provider or admission stage is replayed; no acceptance, admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.
scope_change_reason: The card's original object (#2979's joint rank-7 groups) is already mined by peers through PRs #3411/#3436/#3441/#3285 and related audits. This session audits the arithmetic layer of the newest composed supplier in the same scalar-to-moment lineage instead: PR #3653 is six hours old, has bounded hosted CI but no independent arithmetic reproduction, and its one-identity check (published profile -> published root bracket -> published released kappa -> published delta) is exactly bounded. The audit strength matches the claim layer audited: arithmetic reproduction, not construction review.
bottleneck_link: The complex side binds. PR #3653 reports conditional kappa = 0.001730418899766071163804 - margins in the #3605/#3642 retiming lineage, and an independent check of its profile-to-root arithmetic keeps the composition evidence from resting on author-only arithmetic.
stop_rule: Stop once the profile identities, the bracket straddle under two engines, local uniqueness, the released string and the delta are reproduced and four mutation controls are rejected. No construction, admission or source-review claim.

open_questions.question: Does the published profile itself match the word-level construction (i.e., is the histogram the complete paid invoice, with idle-completion charges and cleanup buffers charged)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This audit reproduces the arithmetic mapping profile -> root -> released value. If the profile miscounted paid work, the same arithmetic would still reproduce. Only a source-bound invoice audit closes that layer.
